name: issuances
description: Every readable row of VerraIssuances_<date>.csv, values exactly as delivered (text, nothing cleaned).
grain: One row per record in the file: one batch of credits issued to a project.

columns.name: program
columns.description: Crediting programme, e.g. Verified Carbon Standard.

columns.name: issuance_date
columns.description: Date the batch was issued, as delivered, e.g. '19 Mar 2009'.

columns.name: sectoral_scope
columns.description: Sectoral scope or scopes; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: methodology
columns.description: Methodology code(s) with version, e.g. 'AMS-I.D. (Version NA)'.

columns.name: additional_certifications_labels
columns.description: Extra labels on the batch, e.g. CCB or CORSIA; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: sustainable_development_contributions
columns.description: Sustainable Development Goals the project claims, e.g. '13: Climate Action'; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: vintage
columns.description: Year, or 'YYYY - YYYY', of the period in which the reductions happened.

columns.name: serial_number
columns.description: Serial-number range of the batch; identifies exactly which credits it holds.

columns.name: units
columns.description: Number of credits (VCUs, one tonne of CO2e each) issued in the batch, as delivered.

columns.name: verifier
columns.description: Body that verified the reductions for this batch.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Region as reported by Verra; sometimes blank or inconsistent.

columns.name: state_province
columns.description: State or province as reported by Verra.

columns.name: validation_status
columns.description: Verra's own check of the row, e.g. PASS.

columns.name: validation_issues
columns.description: What Verra's own check found, if anything.
